title: Weekly Regulation Monitoring Report
executive_summary: Reporting period: 2026-07-09 to 2026-07-16. No HIGH or MEDIUM risk items identified. One LOW-risk European Commission update on child safety online with potential impact on Smart TV modules: Browser/HbbTV, Voice assistant, AI features, Network services, Cybersecurity controls, OTA update, and Remote control/voice input. key_changes.title: European Commission
key_changes.summary: EC special panel report and recommendations on child safety online (LOW impact): initiate child-safety gap assessments, harden default privacy/safety for minors, review data collection/profiling/ads for minors, plan OTA updates and consent flows, conduct/refresh child-focused DPIAs, and monitor for EC follow-up or legislative proposals.
recommended_actions: Obtain and review the EC special panel report and recommendations on child safety online
Gap-assess parental controls, content filtering, safe search, and age-gating in Browser/HbbTV apps
Review data collection, profiling, and advertising practices for minors; disable by default where applicable
Conduct/refresh a child-focused DPIA for voice assistant, AI features, and network services
Harden default privacy and safety settings for child profiles and guest modes
Prepare an OTA plan to deploy child-safety improvements and updated consent flows
Set up monitoring for any EC follow-up or legislative proposals stemming from the report
